name: Marker Highlight & Underline Draw
use: Italic or bold words get a hand-drawn marker band, scribbled underline or rough circle as they scroll into view.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (unminified): three styles, Catmull-Rom path geometry, debounced resize rebuild and exact attribute restore. Highlight is pure CSS on the em/strong (box-decoration-break: clone, so wrapped lines each get a band; lines draw at the same time, not one after another). Underline/circle use one aria-hidden SVG overlay per Text block, appended to .sqs-block outside .sqs-html-content, so the text markup only gains a class while live. Stroke draw uses getTotalLength(), not pathLength. Circle falls back to per-line underline when the word wraps or is longer than circleMax.
